dedupe_keys.name: a database of the coseismic effects following the 30 october 2016 norcia earthquake in central italy

description: A database of the coseismic effects following the 30 October 2016 Norcia earthquake in Central Italy is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Fabio Villani et al. We provide a database of the coseismic geological surface effects following the Mw 6.5 Norcia earthquake that hit central Italy on 30 October 2016. This was one of the strongest seismic events to occur in Europe in the past thirty years, causing complex surface ruptures over an area of >400 km2. Coverage: continental (IT); published in 2018. Formats: TXT. The data are held in PANGAEA and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 51320 data points. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-3.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
